name: braintrust
description: Orchestrate other AI CLIs (Antigravity/agy, Codex, Cursor CLI or Grok for xAI, OpenCode, Claude Code) for second opinions, research, and codebase analysis. No Gemini CLI. One command (peerpanel) runs the panel from a fixed brief. Hybrid always-on skill (eval-backed). Identity-isolated peers (no ambient hooks/MCP).
